title: Toram Online
provenance: Reported by mtits (highball-db#206, 2026-09-24), Apple M1 Pro, macOS 26.5.2, Highball 0.9.36, engine x64-crossover26.3-r8, DXVK, rated 4 of 5 after 233 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Free to play on Steam. The reporter played for almost four hours on DXVK with the steam, vcrun2022 and corefonts recipes and calls it perfect apart from one thing: Japanese text needs Japanese fonts in the environment, which they added by hand. No frame rate was given and nothing was measured here.
knownIssues: Japanese text does not draw until Japanese fonts are installed in the environment. The reporter added them by hand (highball-db#206). There is no font recipe for this yet.
